summary: Meta released Brain2Qwerty v2, a non-invasive brain-to-text decoding research pipeline trained on MEG recordings, along with training code, paper and a partner-released dataset.

practices.reason: The word-accuracy benchmarking methodology for non-invasive brain decoding is a domain-specific eval technique not transferable to general AI engineering work.
practices.quote: achieving a word accuracy rate of 61%, significantly improving upon the 8% word accuracy from other non-invasive methods

practices.reason: The use of AI agents to explore pipeline optimizations is mentioned but with no described method or stated gain to implement.
practices.quote: We also deployed AI agents to explore optimizations for the decoding pipeline, with final training configurations selected manually by engineers.
